column.annotate.text: Should this column receive an ontology-grounded annotation? Answer No for record identifiers, internal codes, timestamps and bookkeeping fields.
options: Yes
No

column.aspect.text: Which aspect of the dataset does this column describe?
options: taxon: the organisms observed, sampled or identified
environment: the biome, habitat or environmental material at a site
method: the sampling protocol, device, assay or processing step
measurement: a measured quantity, quality or attribute of a thing
unit: the unit of measure of a measured quantity
data_type: the kind of record, identifier, dataset or information artifact
location: a named place, region, plot or geographic feature
other: none of the above or not an annotatable column

column.ontology.text: Which ontology should be searched for a term that annotates this column?
options: ENVO: environments, biomes, habitats and environmental materials
NCBITaxon: organisms and taxa at every rank
PATO: qualities and attributes of things (size, sex, age, colour)
UO: units of measurement (meter, degree Celsius, percent)
OBI: investigations, assays, protocols, devices and specimens
IAO: information artifacts, data items, identifiers and documents
PCO: populations, communities and their collective properties
BCO: biological collections, sampling and identification processes
GAZ: named geographic places and administrative regions
RO: relations between entities (part of, located in, participates in)
TAXRANK: taxonomic ranks (species, genus, family, order)
GENEPIO: sample collection, identification and metadata fields

column.ontology_fits.text: Does the ontology described in the state contain the right kind of term for annotating this column?
options: Yes
No

term.fits.text: Is the candidate ontology term a correct annotation for the described column, site or dataset: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?
options: Yes
No

term.fits.chooser.text: Is the candidate ontology term the correct term for the value the user wants to annotate with: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?
options: Yes
No

avu.value_kind.text: What should the AVU value be?
options: the term label
the site code
the column name
the most frequent data value

avu.keep.text: Given the annotations already selected for this dataset, does this annotation add correct, non-redundant information worth keeping?
options: Yes
No

hosted_sql.column.annotate: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Should this column receive an ontology-grounded annotation? Answer No for record identifiers, internal codes, timestamps and bookkeeping fields.', noul := TRUE)
hosted_sql.column.aspect: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Which aspect of the dataset does this column describe?', choice := ['taxon: the organisms observed, sampled or identified', 'environment: the biome, habitat or environmental material at a site', 'method: the sampling protocol, device, assay or processing step', 'measurement: a measured quantity, quality or attribute of a thing', 'unit: the unit of measure of a measured quantity', 'data_type: the kind of record, identifier, dataset or information artifact', 'location: a named place, region, plot or geographic feature', 'other: none of the above or not an annotatable column'])
hosted_sql.column.ontology: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Which ontology should be searched for a term that annotates this column?', choice := ['ENVO: environments, biomes, habitats and environmental materials', 'NCBITaxon: organisms and taxa at every rank', 'PATO: qualities and attributes of things (size, sex, age, colour)', 'UO: units of measurement (meter, degree Celsius, percent)', 'OBI: investigations, assays, protocols, devices and specimens', 'IAO: information artifacts, data items, identifiers and documents', 'PCO: populations, communities and their collective properties', 'BCO: biological collections, sampling and identification processes', 'GAZ: named geographic places and administrative regions', 'RO: relations between entities (part of, located in, participates in)', 'TAXRANK: taxonomic ranks (species, genus, family, order)', 'GENEPIO: sample collection, identification and metadata fields'])
hosted_sql.column.ontology_fits: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Does the ontology described in the state contain the right kind of term for annotating this column?', noul := TRUE)
hosted_sql.term.fits: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Is the candidate ontology term a correct annotation for the described column, site or dataset: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?', noul := TRUE)
hosted_sql.term.fits.chooser: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Is the candidate ontology term the correct term for the value the user wants to annotate with: the right concept at an appropriate specificity, not merely related?', noul := TRUE)
hosted_sql.avu.value_kind: prompt_jev(state_text, 'What should the AVU value be?', choice := ['the term label', 'the site code', 'the column name', 'the most frequent data value'])
hosted_sql.avu.keep: prompt_jev(state_text, 'Given the annotations already selected for this dataset, does this annotation add correct, non-redundant information worth keeping?', noul := TRUE)
